description: The two published GPTQ variants store names that Linear.load does not consume.
trigger: Load either reference -GPTQ-Int4 checkpoint through Qwen3MoeModel.
expected_behavior: A compatible loader would recognize and decode GPTQ's qweight, qzeros, scales and g_idx.
actual_behavior: Neither the EXL3 group nor q_proj.weight matches; the first attention Linear raises 'No tensors found for model.layers.0.self_attn.q_proj matching supported quantization format.' All sampled GPTQ projection auxiliaries remain unread, although their dtypes are recognized.

verification.description: Compared both reference GPTQ header layouts against supported name groups and the first registered attention projection.
verification.limits: Source-level failure path, not execution; no claim of GPTQ support was explicitly made by the commit message.

introductions.rationale: Introduction of Qwen3 MoE dispatch exposes this published-checkpoint compatibility boundary; generic loader restrictions predate this architecture.
